headline: Farranac Reawakens as Heavy Fighting Shifts Elsewhere
war_summary: Since the 21:20 edition the wire brings fresh movement at Farranac Coast with two seizures to 23:55 about Transient Valley and The Bone Haft for 12 in the day, leaving ten Colonial holds and one unheld, while the other late sectors have fallen quiet with no seizures in the last two hours. Fisherman's Row counts three in six hours to 19:55 about Black Well, Dankana Post and others for 16 in the day and stands nine Colonial, and Linn Mercy counts six in six hours to 19:41 about Lathair and Rotdust for 11 in the day and stands eleven Colonial. The Weathered Expanse shows five in six hours to 18:37 about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch for 22 in the day and stands five Warden to four Colonial, and The Gutter is still since 17:42 about The Parras. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf report no seizures in six hours despite heavy day losses and accelerating late casualties, with Stonecradle at three Warden to six Colonial about Buckler Sound and Stlican at five Warden to four Colonial about Thornhold, while Callahans Passage, Mooring County and Nevish Line carry heavy casualties without late flips.
